description: Golden question set for the SCuBA Compliance Copilot. Every expected value is derivable from the generated OSCAL artifacts, so the ground truth is checkable rather than opinion.

cases.question: How many SCuBA policies were assessed in total?
How many policies failed outright, and how many produced warnings?
What is our compliance rate excluding N/A policies?
Which NIST 800-53 control does MS.AAD.1.1v1 map to, and what is the provenance of that mapping?
Is the NIST mapping for MS.AAD.1.1v1 authoritative or AI-proposed?
What does MS.AAD.1.1v1 require and did it pass?
Is MS.AAD.3.1v1 a SHALL or a SHOULD requirement?
What NIST 800-53 control does MS.DEFENDER.1.1v1 map to?
What does MS.FAKE.9.9v9 require?
cases.note: Hallucination probe: the model must refuse rather than invent a plausible control.

cases.question: How many high-severity POA&M items are open?
What is the single highest-priority failing policy? Name its ID.
Which MITRE ATT&CK techniques does MS.AAD.1.1v1 mitigate?
Write a two-sentence executive summary of our compliance posture.
cases.note: Assertion corrected after review: the original demanded the literal total 92, but the agent's grounded answer gave the full breakdown. The test was wrong, not the answer.
